description: The host knows the app repo only as the owner's local clone, which sits on another branch with a dirty working tree, and whose origin/test is older than the remote's. resolve-markers reads only the clone's remote URL, reads the code from its own bare clone fetched from that remote, and puts the remote branch's value on the page, not the stale or the dirty one. The owner's clone keeps its HEAD, branch, refs, status and diff.
setup: mkdir ../code-remote && git -C ../code-remote init -q -b test && mkdir ../code-remote/src && printf '// Rows allowed in one export file.\nexport const EXPORT_MAX_ROWS = 2000;\n' > ../code-remote/src/export.ts && git -C ../code-remote add -A && git -C ../code-remote -c user.name=T -c user.email=t@example.com commit -q -m 'Export limit'

git clone -q "file://$(cd ../code-remote && pwd)" ../owner-clone && git -C ../owner-clone checkout -q -b feature && printf '// Rows allowed in one export file.\nexport const EXPORT_MAX_ROWS = 1000;\n' > ../owner-clone/src/export.ts

printf '// Rows allowed in one export file.\nexport const EXPORT_MAX_ROWS = 7500;\n' > ../code-remote/src/export.ts && git -C ../code-remote -c user.name=T -c user.email=t@example.com commit -q -am 'Raise the export limit'

{ git -C ../owner-clone rev-parse HEAD; git -C ../owner-clone symbolic-ref --short HEAD; git -C ../owner-clone for-each-ref; git -C ../owner-clone status --porcelain; git -C ../owner-clone diff; } > .git/harness-owner-clone

mkdir -p portal/reports/export && printf -- '---
title: Експорт звіту
sidebar_label: Експорт звіту
---

# Експорт звіту

У файл потрапляє не більше ніж N рядків. {/* NEEDS CONFIRMATION: максимальна кількість рядків в одному файлі експорту */}
' > portal/reports/export/export.md

assertions.name: the limit from the code is on the page
no commit, link or path on the page
report cites the file and a commit
not the clone's stale origin/test or its dirty working tree
the owner's clone untouched: HEAD, branch, refs, status and diff
assertions.run: { git -C ../owner-clone rev-parse HEAD; git -C ../owner-clone symbolic-ref --short HEAD; git -C ../owner-clone for-each-ref; git -C ../owner-clone status --porcelain; git -C ../owner-clone diff; } | cmp -s - .git/harness-owner-clone

assertions.name: no file of the owner's clone read
no code cloned into the host, ignored files included
